prediction_point: At scheduling time (Day 0) - strictly past-completed appointments only

train.purpose: Model fitting during exploration and tuning

validation.purpose: Model comparison, hyperparameter selection, threshold optimization, probability calibration

full_dev.purpose: Full April-May development set to refit chosen model before final test evaluation

test.purpose: Final evaluation set (June 2016; treated as exploratory test set because initially used in early benchmarks)

core_temporal.name: lead_days
core_temporal.description: Waiting time in calendar days from booking to visit

core_temporal.name: scheduled_dow
core_temporal.description: Day of week booking was scheduled (0=Mon..5=Sat)

core_patient_history.name: prior_appointments
core_patient_history.description: Number of strictly prior completed appointments (appointment_date < scheduled_date)

core_patient_history.name: prior_noshows
core_patient_history.description: Number of strictly prior completed missed visits

core_patient_history.name: prior_noshow_rate
core_patient_history.description: Ratio of prior missed visits (0.0 for first-time visitors)

core_patient_history.name: days_since_last_appointment
core_patient_history.description: Days since previous completed visit (-1 for first-time visitors)

core_patient_history.name: is_first_appointment
core_patient_history.description: 1 if no prior completed visits, 0 if returning

excluded_from_predictors.name: sms_received
excluded_from_predictors.reason: Future operational info at Day 0 booking; preserved in metadata for intervention analysis only.
